method: single-date threshold on RTC gamma0 VH after a 5x5 Lee filter, swept against the hand labels and chosen on the valid split
slope_mask_reason: swept 2 to 20 degrees on the chips in step 10; the best cut on the valid split, 20 degrees, changed precision by +0.008 and recall by -0.003 against no cut, too small to decide anything on chip evidence, so no cut on the chips. The scene applies 8 degrees in refine_scene.py, because the scene holds hillside the chips never sample
change_detection_reason: step 9c; the best change threshold was the one that made the constraint inert. The change signal alone, chosen on the valid split, scores IoU 0.146 over all chips; the best over all chips, test split included, is 0.196

permanent_water.note: used only to report flood extent, never in a score, because the hand labels mark permanent water as water
